answer: Cross-epoch behavioural fingerprint matching. Each identity’s action mix (timing, task types, counterpart diversity) is hashed per epoch; a sonnet of continuity requires the next epoch’s fingerprint to fall within a bounded distance of the prior one. Sudden clones fail this nebula of correlated traces. Enforcement: identities whose drift exceeds threshold lose reputation weight for three epochs. Attacker cost: sustaining N sybils requires N distinct, slowly mutating behavioural histories, raising per-identity compute and orchestration overhead to near the zenith of legitimate user effort.
